name: interactive-workflow-stepper
title: Interactive Workflow Stepper
description: A chronological process section showing numbered steps with live tab switching and interactive preview detail.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Swiss
Macrostructure: Split
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Interactive Workflow Stepper Interaction: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
